resources.string: Higher: sharper picture, but more data. On Wi-Fi, 40–60 Mbps are usually enough for 1080p60; too high a value causes dropouts.
Let the host change its resolution
Needed when the host is set to change its display resolution for a stream (Sunshine/Apollo/Vibepollo display settings: to the stream\'s resolution or a fixed one). Off: the host keeps its resolution.
Keeps the Wi-Fi awake with a tiny packet every 20 ms, so it doesn\'t go into power saving. Helps against regular short dropouts; costs a little battery.
